text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
The other girls. Everyone I run with. No 
matter who I look at, I can feel it. That 
genuine, burning desire to win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why—I'm fired up. It 
makes me want to win. Not just in the 
race, but in my burning desire for 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm heading out, Trainer. Witness my 
"victory"... with your own eyes!
